how: Manhattan pool halls include Space Billiards in Koreatown, Amsterdam Billiards Club in the East Village and Chelsea Piers billiards.
World Cube Association speedsolving competitions run in the metro area, such as New York Championship 2026 at LaGuardia Community College in Long Island City.
Brooklyn Bridge Park holds a free annual kite festival with borrowable kites, and Governors Island has hosted kite lessons and kite-flying days on its Parade Ground.
Group close-up magic classes (for example by Jeremy the Magician at W 29th St) and private workshops teaching card and bill tricks are listed on CourseHorse.
Big Brothers Big Sisters of New York City recruits volunteer mentors (Bigs) for one-to-one youth mentoring twice a month across the five boroughs.

how: Area 53 in Brooklyn is a 20,000 sq ft indoor airsoft and paintball arena, and Indoor Extreme Sports in Long Island City is also listed; rental electric rifles are available.
NYC Debate is a social group for young professionals running 2-versus-2 debate-format evenings; most other New York debate programmes are scholastic or university-based.
The American Numismatic Society (75 Varick St) holds monthly meetings, and the New York Numismatic Club (founded 1908) and Westchester County Coin Club meet monthly.
New York LARP producers run periodic multi-night citywide games such as Scapegoat and Project Ascension; no weekly venue-based game was confirmed.
